rows.en: Thank you so much for coming to my very first concert tonight, so many of you.
Thank you. It's been five months since our Macross left Earth, and so much has happened. I'm sure many of you have been hurt.
rows.notes: Start of the transcript ('arigatou hee') is garbled; wording trimmed to fit the box.

rows.en: But tonight, forget all that sadness and have a great time.
Now, here's a medley from my first album, coming out soon.

rows.notes: Heard 'shoi-san'; read as 'shoi' (second lieutenant) addressed to Hikaru, could be a name.

rows.en: I'm so happy. You're listening to my songs?
Everyone must be worried... Hey, Lieutenant, where are we?
rows.notes: Heard 'shoi-san'; read as 'shoi' (second lieutenant), could be a name.

rows.en: Huh? Oh, yes. Here you go.
Can't you use the plane's radio?
Right. Anybody? Is anybody there? No good... Fine, I've had enough of my packed schedule anyway.
So now I can finally catch my breath.
What? You believe it too? That's just something the magazine made up!
Hee hee, honestly, I can do that kind of thing as an act. It's business.
You know, I've actually liked you all along. Say you love me.
I see. So you don't love me.
Won't we get scolded for using it unasked?
The melody playing now was decoded from a memory plate handed down in the Zentradi forces since ancient times.
Unfortunately, the lyrics to this song weren't recorded on their memory plate.
So now, the lyricists aboard the Macross are writing wonderful lyrics for this song.
We'll broadcast this song across the universe, make peace with the Meltrandi too, and create a world without war.
I don't know what happened between you and that person, but still, I like you.
rows.notes: Transcript says 'that person'; gender of the other party not stated.

rows.en: You say it isn't true? A misunderstanding?
That's too cruel. It's too much.

rows.notes: Transcript has 'hikaru' as the word for light; read as the name Hikaru.

rows.en: You came. You came for me.
Huh? What is that? Why do I have to sing the song that person found?
Even if I sing that, there's no chance we'll win!
Forget that. Stay with me, Hikaru. If we're going to die anyway, I want to stay together like this.
That has nothing to do with it! Why aren't we the only two people in the world?
I wish everyone except you and me would just die.
Sigh, I'm sorry, Hikaru. I wasn't myself. I chose this path because I wanted to, after all.

rows.notes: Fragment 'konna koto'; guessed a dismissive reply to an attack.

rows.en: I won't let you get away!

rows.notes: Whisper flagged no speech; text taken at face value, enemy subject added.
